title: Zero-Shot Coordination among LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.06409v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study zero-shot coordination (ZSC), where independently developed agents must coordinate at test time. While ZSC has been well studied in the RL literature, far less is known about the performance of LLM agents despite their increasing deployment in such settings. Existing work on LLM coordination often relies on specialised scaffolding that independently developed agents are unlikely to share in practice. Moreover, evaluations on complex environments (e.g., Hanabi) make it difficult to pinpoint the sources of coordination failure. In contrast, we focus on simple, general-purpose scaffolds in minimal environments designed to isolate specific coordination challenges. Our results show that even in these controlled settings, frontier LLM agents struggle to coordinate, largely due to limited understanding of the coordination problem and weak reasoning about their partner's beliefs. translated_title: 大语言模型智能体之间的零样本协调
translated_abstract: 我们研究零样本协调，即独立开发的智能体必须在测试时进行协调的场景。尽管零样本协调在强化学习文献中已被充分研究，但对于大语言模型智能体在此类设置中的性能却知之甚少，尽管它们在此类环境中的部署日益增多。现有的LLM协调工作通常依赖于专门化的脚手架架构，而独立开发的智能体在实践中不太可能共享这些架构。此外，在复杂环境（如Hanabi）上进行评估使得难以准确定位协调失败的根源。相比之下，我们专注于在最小化环境中使用简单、通用的脚手架架构，这些环境旨在隔离特定的协调挑战。我们的结果表明，即使在这些受控设置中，前沿LLM智能体也难以协调，这主要是由于对协调问题的理解有限以及对合作伙伴信念的推理能力较弱。虽然LLM引入了语义信息作为额外的（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文通过设计隔离特定协调挑战的最小化环境与简单通用脚手架，首次系统研究了独立开发的LLM智能体之间的零样本协调问题，发现即使最前沿的LLM智能体也难以协调，其主要原因在于对协调问题的理解有限以及对合作伙伴信念的推理能力较弱。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies zero-shot coordination among independently developed LLM agents using minimal environments and simple general-purpose scaffolds to isolate specific coordination challenges, finding that even frontier LLM agents struggle to coordinate, largely due to limited understanding of the coordination problem and weak reasoning about their partner's beliefs.
